title: Background Rechecks and Identity Checks: Figures for Each Wayfare Driver Level
content:
The background recheck and identity check figures of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product are the same on all six Wayfare levels, and are listed level by level here.

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Months after the latest background check date until the next check falls due | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Overdue recheck places the agreement on hold until a result arrives | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Business days to respond to a pre-adverse action notice after a consider result | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Failed real-time identity photo check places the agreement on hold | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

**Business days** for the response period are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays; they run from the pre-adverse action notice that follows a consider result, and a final decision follows the period.

**Recheck interval** is counted in months after the background check date on the agreement.

Hypothetical reading: a clear background check dated 2025-11-03 makes the next recheck fall due 12 months later, in November 2026.
